blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two prosecutors said on Wednesday that the House prosecution panel withdrew three articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte after determining that her defense team allegedly planned to stall or delay her trial. “We have seen through their strategy. They will just prolong the process because, to be honest, they have no evidence to present,” Manila Rep. Joel Chua told reporters. In a surprise announcement on Tuesday, lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said that they have decided to drop three of the four articles of impeachment against Duterte—misuse of confidential funds (Article 1), death threats […]...
